title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Brotherhood
Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E15 — Lee Farkas/Taylor Bean & Whitaker: Financial Home Invasion
Lee Farkas invents fake loans and funnels millions in a scam that leaves thousands jobless and leads to one of the largest bank failures in America.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E8 — The Real Wolf of Wall Street
Stockbroker Jordan Belfort pleads guilty to fraud and does jail time; Belfort gets a Hollywood makeover.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E17 — Something's Fishy: The Codfather
Carlos Rafael makes millions as the owner of one of the largest commercial fishing businesses on the East Coast, but his big mouth gets him hooked in an undercover IRS sting with agents posing as Russian mobsters.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E8 — Flipping Frenzy Scam
Would-be marketing mogul Jeanetta Standefor relies on investor trust and faith when she convinces clients that their cash is rescuing homeowners from foreclosure.

title: American Greed
description:
S14 E6 — Social Media Scam Artists
Crowdfunded charities are supposed raise funds for good causes, but some are actually scams.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E7 — The Fake Prince's Royal Scam
An outlandish con artist poses as a Saudi royal to cheat investors out of millions by promising them access to Arabian oil stock; from his penthouse on Fisher Island, phony sultan Khalid Bin Al-Saud lures victims with dreams of untold riches.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E12 — The Tran Organization: Blackjack Cheaters
Van Thu Tran and her crime ring steal millions by cheating casinos.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E13 — The Lawyer Lies; Black Gold Bust
An Indianapolis attorney helps desperate families recover money after serious injuries cost them dearly, but pockets the winnings of widows and orphans.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E8 — Fouled Out: Rumeal Robinson
A former champion basketball player's schemes land him in prison and his mother is kicked out of her home.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E12 — Cybercrime: The Iceman
Computer hacker Max Butler's online scheme which sold millions of stolen credit cards leads the feds on a year-long chase.
